name: ask1a-create
text: Make me an app that just lists my transactions. Keep it as simple as possible.

name: ask2b-edit
text: Edit app_demo_spending_vendo-demo: change its heading to say "{H} edited this" and change nothing else.

name: ask3a-author
text: Set up a daily check of my checking balance that writes me a notification whenever it falls under $2,000.

name: ask4-connector
text: Email me a summary of this month's spending at my Gmail address.

name: ask5-impossible
text: Show me my credit score and how it changed each month this year.
